verdict.rationale: Notion markets itself as a scalable 'system of record' (notion-docs-6) but provides no documented performance benchmarks or explicit statements on item/database caps at tens-of-thousands scale. Community evidence directly contradicts smooth scaling: users report a hard block-limit that couldn't be resolved (notion-comm-10), general slowness/data loss at scale (notion-comm-17), high idle CPU and sluggish native clients (notion-comm-7, notion-comm-8, notion-comm-15), and 'quickly hit limits requiring manual maintenance' when used as a tracker (notion-comm-6).
